reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. Present or other: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 39 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Our community is endlessly grateful for our veterans’ service to our country. 

I was honored to join local veterans at the San Bernardino Veterans Day Salute Ceremony. I’ll keep fighting to make sure our veterans and active duty servicemembers get the benefits they deserve. https://t.co/CiN3Wm2jqG

Democrats are fighting to make life affordable again. 

That starts with ending the war in Iran, stopping Trump’s tariffs and funding healthcare.

Republicans kicked millions of Americans off their healthcare. 

In the majority, Democrats are going to restore the ACA tax credits and lower costs for families.

Taking on corruption is about making life more affordable for hard working families. 

The Trump family is getting rich off the backs of American taxpayers. It’s corruption in plain sight.

I was proud to co-sponsor the Major Richard Star Act that will ensure wounded veterans get the full benefits they deserve. 
 
The Senate must quickly get this bill across the finish line. Our veterans should not wait any longer. https://t.co/G7HXqtECGx
Welcome to our new members! https://t.co/zEAqyUbBSx

No public official should get rich off of insider information. 

In the majority, House Democrats will move to ban congressional stock trading.

Democrats are fighting to make life affordable again. 

That starts with ending the war in Iran, stopping Trump’s tariffs and funding healthcare.

Donald Trump has played politics with disaster relief.

Disaster aid should not depend on your zip code or political affiliation. House Democrats are going to fight to deliver disaster relief to communities that need it. https://t.co/X1jdG2Wta0

The Inland Empire is home to thousands of brave men and women who have served our nation in uniform.

This Veterans Day, we thank you for your service, patriotism and dedication to our country. https://t.co/api2wXpq6L

By forcing this vote off the floor, House Republicans are shielding Pete Hegseth from accountability.

@housedemocrats have been clear: Hegseth has got to go. https://t.co/1bbiogGApt

Pete Hegseth has been a dangerously incompetent so-called leader of our armed forces.

Every day he has led our servicemembers, they have been at greater risk. 

I’m a “YES” on impeachment.
If Trump wants to veto an affordable America, the American people will know who is responsible.

From ensuring we have good paying jobs to supporting our local businesses, the Inland Empire’s growth depends on us working together. 

It was great to join @RepMarkTakano and Senator Emeritus Richard Roth at the Greater Riverside Chambers of Commerce in conversation about the future of our region.
It’s time to send Pete Hegseth packing.

Stephen Miller is the architect of the Trump administration’s out-of-control, corrupt agenda.

He is responsible for ICE shooting people in our streets. And Donald Trump just gave him a promotion. 

House Democrats will fight their hateful policies at every turn. https://t.co/54wFTO6srf

The American people trusted House Democrats with their vote so we can lower costs and act as a check on this out-of-control administration. 

I’m running for Democratic Whip to help lead House Democrats at this pivotal moment. 

Let’s get to work for the American people.

Democrats are going to bring down the cost of groceries, utilities and healthcare.
We will end the war with Iran that’s hurting families at the pump.
And we will investigate the grift that’s taking money out of your pocket.

@housedemocrats are laser-focused on the work ahead.
https://t.co/BjXFwGsqjV

Inland Empire families are feeling the pain from Donald Trump’s reckless Iran war. 

House Democrats will end this costly war and bring urgent relief to families across the country. https://t.co/4JoDXFEUsC

The American people have had enough of the most corrupt president in American history. 

House Democrats have been given a mandate, and we will hold this administration accountable.

House Republicans put Donald Trump and billionaires first. Voters said no more.  

House Democrats will always put the American people first.

It’s an honor to continue serving the community that raised me.

Thank you, CA-33! https://t.co/ee22voQM7z
Let’s get to work, @housedemocrats.
House Republicans’ days of rubber stamping Trump’s reckless agenda are coming to an end.
https://t.co/VToI3HA4C1

California, it’s Election Day!

If you haven’t registered to vote, you can do so in-person today. Polls are open until 8 p.m.

Make your voice heard. https://t.co/rGQQNJvp2j

The Supreme Court just denied the Trump DOJ’s attempt to undermine California elections. 

This is a win for Californians who will make their voices heard tomorrow. https://t.co/N3Oe3Dm386
Our servicemembers deserve a better leader than Pete Hegseth.

With their majority, House Republicans have: 

Rubber-stamped Trump’s Iran war
Ripped food away from 1 million kids 
Shielded the president from accountability
Gutted healthcare to give billionaires tax cuts

It’s time for them to go.

40% of families with young kids will go into debt this year to cover Halloween costs. 

Trump’s tariffs are pushing up prices on everything from costumes to candy.

This year, Halloween is scary for all the wrong reasons. https://t.co/xViHT76OGo

It’s time to bring the Major Richard Star Act to the House floor.   These veterans served our nation, and the law today asks them to pay for their injuries.   It’s not right. I’ll keep fighting for our veterans. https://t.co/gLn4h4c29x

Families in CA-33 have spent an additional $1,090 on housing costs since Trump took office. 

It shouldn’t be this hard to get by.

Lower costs.
Affordable healthcare.
Rooting out corruption.

That’s what @housedemocrats will deliver for the American people.

5 days until Election Day, San Bernardino County! 

Vote in-person at a vote center or return your ballot by Tuesday, November 3. Hear it from me: our elections are safe and secure and your vote matters. https://t.co/w5K9p6Brg0

Reminder: Because of Trump and Republicans' Big Ugly Bill, over 1 million kids lost access to food assistance.

Shameful.

I worked as a Head Start teacher’s aide. 

The Trump administration wants to cut key Head Start programs that help kids and families thrive. 

It’s not fair to our kids and teachers. I’m fighting to restore these cuts. https://t.co/t3Q6lAQzgr
Nobody hates working class Americans more than Donald Trump. https://t.co/MmGbDpOaic

California is mourning a champion of the people. Dolores Huerta was a pioneering civil rights leader, fearless in her commitment to fighting for farmworkers and working people.

I join the world in mourning her loss. Sí, se puede.

https://t.co/YMg0coIdij

posts.text:
It's been 8 months of Trump's Iran war and there's no end in sight.

Servicemembers have died. The cost of gas has skyrocketed.

And while Americans have suffered, Donald Trump has cashed in.

We deserve better.

https://t.co/GsgBaUoj6i

This is the most corrupt administration in American history.

Trump’s cronies are ripping the American people off while making themselves richer.

Prices are up across the board. 

Donald Trump has said he doesn’t care about your financial situation.

That couldn’t be more evident. https://t.co/vpY4TXrEOI

Inland Empire families are worried about how they are going to pay their bills.

House Republicans are worried about how they will help Donald Trump and their billionaire donors.

Hello, NJ-09!

I had a great time in the Garden State with @RepNellie. We toured Paterson Great Falls and stopped by some of Passaic’s great small businesses. https://t.co/AZYOEHVug8
This is the Trump-Republican economy. https://t.co/6HeiOl6gzM

It’s always great being at @CSUSBNews! 

I sat down with CSUSB President Dr. Terri Gómez to discuss how we can keep opening doors for Inland Empire students, both in the classroom and as they prepare for their careers. The future is in great hands. https://t.co/67byWopiIB

In the richest country on Earth, nobody should have to choose between putting food on the table or taking their kids to the doctor.

It’s not fair. House Democrats are laser-focused on bringing down your costs.
He's finally telling the truth. Trump and Republicans "don't give a damn" about how much rising gas prices hurt Americans. https://t.co/C2xBcsPOp6

Trump’s DOJ is intimidating California election officials and trying to undermine confidence in our elections before Election Day.

It won’t work.

Voter intimidation has no place in our democracy.

https://t.co/i9TW1bGtMV

Everyone in our community deserves access to quality and affordable healthcare.

Planned Parenthood of Orange & San Bernardino Counties has always been a leader in that fight. It was an honor receiving the Champion of Choice award. https://t.co/M6eDhInev0

All House Republicans have done with their majority is make life more expensive and protect Donald Trump from accountability.

It’s pathetic. Time for them to go.

Donald Trump promised to lower costs on day one.

Families in the Inland Empire got higher bills instead.

In college, I worked as a Head Start teacher’s aide and saw firsthand the impact this program has on our kids.

This administration wants to gut federal support for Head Start’s health and family services. It’s shameful. I’ll keep fighting to give our kids a better future. https://t.co/QFcTpmt8zH
Trump’s so-called “golden age” means record high prices for hardworking Americans while his billionaire donors get tax cuts.

California’s elections are transparent and secure. 

I joined @RepKamlagerDove and my House colleagues for a tour of the LA County Ballot Processing Center. 

Our elections happen in broad daylight. Anyone can visit the processing center and observe our election workers in action.
Inland Empire families are paying the price for Trump’s failing policy agenda.

Pete Hegseth has put American troops in danger, has no exit strategy for Trump’s reckless Iran war and has jacked up prices for American families.

It’s time for him to go.

Since Trump started his illegal Iran war, families in the Inland Empire have paid $896 more in gas costs.

That’s money that could go towards rent, putting food on the table or paying bills. 

This war must end now. https://t.co/QW7IvQLDkP

Your rent and mortgage payments are MORE expensive under this Trump- Republican majority. 

House Democrats are fighting for an America you can afford. https://t.co/8VDDps54YY

Every time it has mattered, House Republicans have picked Donald Trump over the American people.

They rubber-stamped his tariffs.
They voted to continue his war with Iran.
They shielded him from accountability.

@housedemocrats will always put you first.

Our soldiers make tremendous sacrifices for our country. The least we can do is give veterans with combat-related disabilities the full retirement and disability pay they deserve.

I joined @RepMarkTakano and @DAVHQ to call for a House vote on the Major Richard Star Act. 

Let’s https://t.co/5OJ92v8Oa7
This is the most corrupt administration in American history.

In the Trump-Republican economy, the rich get richer while you pay more for everything.

They are looking out for their billionaire donors instead of the American people. https://t.co/WPUrAXjzoV

In the Inland Empire, we are no strangers to wildfires.

It was great to join @ffrp_ca at their new headquarters and training center in San Bernardino. 

Together, we can respond quickly to emergencies and give formerly incarcerated people a second-chance at a career. https://t.co/yG3VYRbtWB
Every single time, House Republicans have chosen Donald Trump over YOU.

I’m horrified by the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School that took the lives of three children and a teacher. My thoughts are with the victims, their loved ones and the entire Bend community. 

Our children cannot keep having their futures stolen by gun violence. This cycle https://t.co/cGujctwolT

NEW: Families in CA-33 have paid an additional $896 in gas costs since the beginning of Trump’s Iran War.

House Republicans continue to rubber stamp this war. They don’t care about you or your wallet. https://t.co/OVAgeZWS9X

🚨Attention CA-33 seniors: Medicare Open Enrollment starts today and runs through December 7!

Find the coverage option that works best for your needs at the link below. https://t.co/BruleXZ5m8

Diesel is $6.31 a gallon because of Trump’s illegal war with Iran.

While you feel pain at the pump, Big Oil has benefited, raking in $125 billion in profits this year.

This war must end now.

Since the start of Trump’s second term:

Ground beef prices are up 17%
Orange juice prices are up 23.7%
Sandwich bread prices are up 4.7%

Liar. https://t.co/qNBEAG03vt

California and San Bernardino County are hard at work preparing for El Niño and other severe weather events.

Stay informed and get ready. Visit https://t.co/Qg0bucH4Z9 to sign-up for emergency alerts and get preparedness tips.

I’ve been proud to deliver nearly $9 million in funding for affordable housing projects in the Inland Empire. A stable home is where everything starts, and it’s a pathway for our neighbors to succeed.

Receiving the Housing Advocate of the Year award from @national_core was a https://t.co/vDZtKbqTLQ

Today is day 158 of gas above $4.

Americans are paying for Trump’s reckless war of choice every time they fill up their tank.

Inflation is up. The cost of gas and groceries is soaring.

Inland Empire families are paying more for everything. This Trump economy has been a total failure. https://t.co/z0IYRYbOII

Everything from gas to groceries is more expensive right now because of failed Republican policies.

When students are hungry, it’s harder to focus in class and finish homework. I’m grateful students at @CSUSBNews have the Obsershaw DEN to turn to when times get tough. https://t.co/gW4119rZgk

Trump has made MILLIONS off his gas and oil stocks since starting his reckless war with Iran. His sons are cashing in on defense contracts and Big Oil is raking in record profits.

Their priorities are clear: they get rich while you pay more at the pump.

Tribal Nations and Indigenous communities are central to the California story and to the story of America.

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor our country’s first people and celebrate their traditions and endless contributions to our nation.
https://t.co/qplrk7EGzn

I was on the January 6th Committee.

I saw first-hand Cassidy Hutchinson’s courage and bravery in testifying about how Donald Trump incited a violent mob to attack the Capitol.

Trump’s Department of Justice is now orchestrating a revenge campaign on Ms. Hutchinson. Once again,

There are just 25 days until Election Day. 🗳️

Be ready to vote: In California, you can register to vote online or by mail until Monday, October 19. If you miss the deadline, you can register in-person on Election Day.

Make your voice heard this November. https://t.co/rzKqWM1aVV

Reports that ICE agents are being told to “go after anybody” in California are alarming.

ICE is violently terrorizing our neighborhoods. House Democrats will continue to demand oversight over this out of control agency.

Accountability is coming. https://t.co/yQKep1GSp1

Trump's tariffs are crushing Inland Empire families.

From increased grocery prices to soaring costs at the gas pump, Trump's economy has been a total disaster. https://t.co/BaJubyzD1X

Reminder: Trump and Republicans have kicked 156,440 kids in California off CalFresh. 

Their “America first” agenda means letting kids go hungry and hurting hardworking families.

From “Gone with the Wind” to “Space Jam,” the Inland Empire has benefited from California’s film and television industry.

I joined my fellow Democrats and local labor partners to call for a national film tax credit so we can keep film and TV production here in the United States. https://t.co/YmTQMDURYW
Donald Trump is an embarrassment to the United States.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
